fig-entropy-venn-2025-12-06-1050

```{r}
#| label: fig-entropy-venn
#| fig-cap: "Relationship between entropies and mutual information"
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

# Create a conceptual diagram using ggplot2
# Two overlapping circles representing H(X) and H(Y)

# Circle centers and radius
circles <- tibble::tibble(
  x0 = c(-0.6, 0.6),
  y0 = c(0, 0),
  r  = c(1.2, 1.2),
  label = c("H(X)", "H(Y)")
)

# Annotations
annotations <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(-1.1, 1.1, 0, 0),
  y = c(0, 0, 0, -1.8),
  label = c("H(X|Y)", "H(Y|X)", "MI(X,Y)", "H(X,Y) = H(X) + H(Y) − MI(X,Y)"),
  size = c(4, 4, 4, 3.5)
)

g_entropy_venn <- circles |> 
  ggplot2::ggplot(mapping = aes(
    x = x, y = y
  )) + 
  ggforce::geom_circle(
    data = circles,
    mapping = aes(x0 = x, y0 = y, r = 1),
    fill = c("steelblue", "coral"),
    alpha = 0.3,
    color = "gray30",
    linewidth = 1
  ) + 
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = circles,
    mapping = aes(x = x0, y = 1.5, label = label),
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) + 
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = annotations[1:3, ],
    mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    size = annotations$size[1:3]
  ) + 
  ggplot2::annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0, y = -1.8,
    label = expression(H[X*","*Y] == H[X] + H[Y] - MI(X,Y)),
    size = 4
  ) + 
  ggplot2::coord_fixed() + 
  ggplot2::theme_void() + 
  ggplot2::xlim(-2.5, 2.5) + 
  ggplot2::ylim(-2.2, 2)

g_entropy_venn

```
